title: Thai Zesty Chicken Wrap
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make chicken wrap recipe, perfect for a quick lunch or dinner. This recipe combines the zesty flavors of Thailand with the convenience of a wrap.
instructions: 1. In a small bowl, whisk together zesty Thai sauce and tangerine juice.
2. Heat a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
3. Add coconut oil to the pan and swirl it around.
4. Add the chicken breast to the pan and cook for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
5. Let the chicken rest for a few minutes before slicing it thinly.
6. Warm the large flour tortilla in the microwave or in a dry pan for a few seconds.
7. Assemble the wrap by placing the sliced chicken on the tortilla, followed by shredded carrots and chopped cilantro.
8. Drizzle the zesty Thai sauce over the top of the wrap.
